eyebrow: Reading secrets out of the environment
code:
import os

api_key = os.environ["CARRIER_API_KEY"]        # raises if unset
api_key = os.environ.get("CARRIER_API_KEY")     # None if unset
api_key = os.environ.get("CARRIER_API_KEY", "")  # fallback value
caption: Fail loudly on a missing secret -- don't default it quietly.

code:
# .env  (never committed to git)
CARRIER_API_KEY=sk_test_51Hs9k2...
WAREHOUSE_DB_PASSWORD=NbRetail!2026secure

# app.py
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os

load_dotenv()
api_key = os.environ["CARRIER_API_KEY"]
caption: load_dotenv() injects .env values into os.environ.
